general_baseline.note: derived in this layer; no formal opportunity contract is mounted

hourly_granularity.fail_closed: missing weather or unknown fields → g=null, no fitting subjects, no fabricated reason
hourly_granularity.rule: general-v0.1 per hour, weather metrics only; subjects_fitting = curated subject whose good_hours window covers the hour (sub-hour stamps fold to the covering :00 bucket); night hours without a covering window sit in the neutral na bucket
hourly_granularity.same_run: generated only from the bundle run the evaluations-details carry (asserted fail-fast, CHALLENGER-14/A)

civil_light.rule: CL-DATA-68 minute-level window boundaries (civil -6 deg et al.) computed from the place coordinate + NOAA/Meeus altitude chain, cached once per place-day; civil-light judgments use the interval intersection, the hourly grid instant stays the honest fallback when the geometry yields no boundary

tier_semantics.rule: CL-DATA-68 time-aware tier (owner-approved): today rows judge the REMAINING period after tier_evaluated_at — recommend when a curated subject window still has qualifying minutes ahead (window end = minute-level sun-elevation window interval, capped by the last qualified hour bucket); shootable (「窗已過·今日仍可拍」) when every curated window passed or never matched but the remaining-period general baseline passes; not_recommended (short remaining reason) when the remaining baseline also fails; no known remaining hour stays honest-null. Cross-day rows keep the full-day rules (tier_basis=full_day).
